parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The application name of the network object.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return. Default value: **1**, which indicates the first page.

parameters.name: ImageList
parameters.description: The list of images included in the network object.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The namespace of the network object.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries per page for paging. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned by default.
> Do not leave PageSize empty.

parameters.name: TagList
parameters.description: The list of tags included in the network object.

parameters.name: TargetName
parameters.description: The name of the network object.

parameters.name: TargetType
parameters.description:
The object type. Valid values:
- IMAGE: image.
